scope: Primary sources for a Flickr8k released-model caption comparison and metric agreement study
evidence_status: Literature and method planning only. No project model results.

sources.title: Framing Image Description as a Ranking Task: Data, Models and Evaluation Metrics
supports: 8,000 benchmark images and five captions per image
Earlier caption ranking and human evaluation work
sources.limits: Ranking existing captions differs from free-form caption generation. Acquired local split files still need validation.

sources.title: Original Flickr8k download and caption notices
supports: Authors do not own image copyright
Educational and noncommercial research download context
sources.limits: These notices do not grant a new blanket license to every image. A third-party mirror label does not replace source terms.

sources.title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
supports: Captioning and filtering of noisy training data
sources.limits: Published paper scores are not measurements for this repository or its proposed Flickr8k run.

sources.title: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-base model card
supports: Direct processor and model inference interface
sources.limits: Pin a revision for a run. The mutable card does not certify exclusion of Flickr8k from pretraining.

sources.title: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large model card
sources.limits: Different released checkpoints do not isolate parameter count as a causal factor.

sources.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
supports: Frozen image encoder and language model
sources.limits: Pretraining efficiency does not imply that local inference uses less memory than BLIP.

sources.title: Salesforce/blip2-opt-2.7b model card
sources.limits: Hugging Face wrote the card. Parameter storage estimates exclude peak inference overhead.

sources.title: Bleu: a Method for Automatic Evaluation of Machine Translation
sources.limits: A sentence BLEU average is not the corpus BLEU statistic. Exact overlap does not certify visual accuracy.

sources.title: METEOR: An Automatic Metric for MT Evaluation with Improved Correlation with Human Judgments
sources.limits: Implementations and lexical resources change the exact score. METEOR does not inspect the image.

sources.title: CIDEr: Consensus-Based Image Description Evaluation
sources.limits: Specify the implemented variant and scaling. Use a fixed corpus for document frequencies.

sources.title: BERTScore: Evaluating Text Generation with BERT
supports: Encoder, layer, IDF, and rescaling choices
sources.limits: Text similarity does not verify visual facts. Scores depend on the fixed encoder and options.

sources.title: CLIPScore: A Reference-free Evaluation Metric for Image Captioning
sources.limits: Raw cosine is a different statistic. High compatibility does not prove every caption claim.

sources.title: Object Hallucination in Image Captioning
supports: Sentence scores and hallucination can disagree
sources.limits: The COCO protocol does not transfer unchanged to Flickr8k without suitable annotations.

sources.title: Twenty Years of Confusion in Human Evaluation: NLG Needs Evaluation Sheets and Standardised Definitions
sources.limits: The project's proposed 1-5 accuracy and detail rubric requires a pilot and does not inherit validation from this paper.

sources.title: Microsoft COCO Caption Evaluation
supports: Corpus CIDEr document frequency and length penalty
sources.limits: The original repository targets old Python and Java versions. A modern port needs pinned versions and parity checks.
